reason: A DSH outbound network routing plugin that globally manages direct and proxy paths for fetch and optionally Node.js HTTP(S) requests using configurable rules, fallback behavior, health memory, and protected proxy credentials.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 统一管理出站 HTTP(S) 与 SOCKS 网络路由，支持按主机和调用上下文选择直连、代理、回退或阻断策略。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that manages outbound HTTP(S) and SOCKS routing with configurable host and caller-context rules for direct, proxy, fallback, or blocked connections.

capabilities: Intercepts and routes process-wide fetch and optionally Node.js HTTP(S) requests
Supports HTTP(S) and SOCKS proxy connections with named proxy rules
Applies host, provider, and plugin routing actions including direct, proxy, fallback, and block
Stores per-target latency and failure health state for routing decisions
Integrates with environment and operating-system proxy settings
Uses credential references for proxy authentication
Provides configuration and sanitized status surfaces
